title: Ten Floors Down
license: CC0-1.0 / MIT (100% self-authored procedural Canvas 2D geometry & WebAudio synthesis)

visualAssets.description: Chiseled stone walls, mossy dungeon floor flagstones, wooden doors, subterranean stairs (up/down), glowing Alchemy Desk, and hazard overlays (Liquid Flame embers, Frost Mist crystals, Caustic Gas clouds, Boss Telegraph reticles).
Distinct silhouettes and weapon/crest badges for Ironclad Vanguard (shield + helm), Shadow Rogue (hooded cloak + twin daggers), and Arcane Alchemist (alchemical robe + arcane staff).
Six color-coded glass vial renderings (Crimson, Amber, Viridian, Azure, Violet, Obsidian) with liquid meniscus and identified/unidentified status badges.

Ten distinct dungeon enemies including Sewer Rat, Gnoll Scout, Plague Swarm, Skeleton Guard, Prison Brute, Cinder Shaman, Void Stalker, Golem Sentinel, Floor 5 Mini-Boss (The Iron Warden), and Floor 10 Final Boss (The Abyssal Core).

audioAssets.description: Low-pass filtered noise burst + subtle resonant thud simulating subterranean stone footsteps.
Dual-oscillator metallic FM strike and impact transient for melee weapon hits.
High-frequency crystalline chime burst + fizzing noise envelope when throwing or drinking potions.
Ascending major-fifth harmonic arpeggio signaling permanent potion identification or Scroll of Upgrade.
Sub-bass sawtooth rumble warning of an impending Floor 5 or Floor 10 boss AoE slam.
